```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(mitch)

select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r load-pca}
# PC scores: PC1/PC2 only (PC4+ confirmed as noise)
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

mitch_input <- pca_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

cat("PC input:", nrow(mitch_input), "genes x", ncol(mitch_input), "contrasts\n")
```

```{r load-supp-tables}
# Mahendrawada et al. 2025 (Supp Table 3.xlsx). S3a: binary TF binding
# matrix (genes x 178 TFs). S3c: log2FC after TF depletion, significant
# genes only, plus Kmeans_clusters column. Sign convention: negative
# log2FC = gene repressed on TF depletion (TF normally activates it);
# positive log2FC = gene induced on depletion (TF normally represses
# it). S3e integrates S3a + S3c for direct targets only.
#
# Reads "Supp Table 3 updated.xlsx" (output of 00_add_dot6_tod6.R),
# matching the file used by scripts 07 and 09 so all three draw from
# the same source.
supp_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3 updated.xlsx")

table_a <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_c <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3c")
table_e <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3e")

cat("Table A dimensions:", nrow(table_a), "genes x", ncol(table_a), "columns\n")
cat("Table C dimensions:", nrow(table_c), "genes x", ncol(table_c), "columns\n")
cat("Table E dimensions:", nrow(table_e), "genes x", ncol(table_e), "columns\n")
```

```{r build-genesets-table-a}
# Table A gene sets: for each TF, collect genes where binding = 1.
# Minimum 5 bound genes per TF.
tf_cols_a <- colnames(table_a)[-1]   # drop gene_id column

genesets_a <- map(tf_cols_a, function(tf) {
  table_a %>%
    filter(.data[[tf]] == 1) %>%
    pull(gene_id)
}) %>%
  set_names(paste0(tf_cols_a, "_bound"))

# filter to TFs binding at least 5 genes
genesets_a <- genesets_a[map_int(genesets_a, length) >= 5]
cat("Table A: ", length(genesets_a), "TF binding gene sets (>= 5 genes)\n")
```

```{r build-genesets-table-c}
# Table C gene sets: activated and repressed targets per TF. Drop
# Kmeans_clusters column, then pivot to long format. Activated targets:
# log2FC < 0 (gene down when TF depleted, TF normally keeps it up).
# Repressed targets: log2FC > 0 (gene up when TF depleted, TF normally
# keeps it down).
tf_cols_c <- colnames(table_c) %>%
  setdiff(c("gene_id", "Kmeans_clusters"))

table_c_long <- table_c %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, all_of(tf_cols_c)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

# activated gene sets (log2FC < 0)
genesets_c_activated <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_activated"))

# repressed gene sets (log2FC > 0)
genesets_c_repressed <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_repressed"))

genesets_c <- c(genesets_c_activated, genesets_c_repressed)
cat("Table C:", length(genesets_c_activated), "activated gene sets |",
    length(genesets_c_repressed), "repressed gene sets\n")
```

```{r build-genesets-table-e}
# Table E: direct activation/repression (bound + regulated). Same sign
# convention as Table C. Column 1 is gene_id.
tf_cols_e <- colnames(table_e)[-1]

table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_e_activated <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_direct_activated"))

genesets_e_repressed <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_direct_repressed"))

genesets_e <- c(genesets_e_activated, genesets_e_repressed)
cat("Table E:", length(genesets_e_activated), "direct activated gene sets |",
    length(genesets_e_repressed), "direct repressed gene sets\n")
```

```{r check-dot6-tod6-table-e}
# Diagnostic: confirm whether Dot6_Tod6 clears Table E's >= 5 gene
# threshold, and how many genes it has non-NA log2FC for. Table E is
# the intersection of Table A and Table C, so this isn't guaranteed.
dot6_tod6_e_activated <- sum(map_int(genesets_e_activated, length) >= 5 &
                              str_detect(names(genesets_e_activated), "Dot6_Tod6"))
cat("Dot6_Tod6 direct activated set present in Table E:",
    "Dot6_Tod6_direct_activated" %in% names(genesets_e), "\n")
if ("Dot6_Tod6" %in% colnames(table_e)) {
  n_overlap_e <- table_e %>% filter(!is.na(Dot6_Tod6)) %>% nrow()
  cat("Genes with non-NA Dot6_Tod6 log2FC in Table E:", n_overlap_e, "\n")
}
```

```{r check-gene-overlap}
# Sanity check: confirm reasonable overlap between PCA genes and TF
# target gene IDs before running enrichment
pca_gene_ids <- rownames(mitch_input)

overlap_a <- length(intersect(pca_gene_ids, unlist(genesets_a)))
overlap_c <- length(intersect(pca_gene_ids, unlist(genesets_c)))
overlap_e <- length(intersect(pca_gene_ids, unlist(genesets_e)))

cat("Genes in PCA:", length(pca_gene_ids), "\n")
cat("PCA genes found in Table A targets:", overlap_a, "\n")
cat("PCA genes found in Table C targets:", overlap_c, "\n")
cat("PCA genes found in Table E targets:", overlap_e, "\n")
```

```{r run-mitch-tf}
# Run mitch for all three table-derived gene set collections.
# priority = "effect" ranks by s.dist (effect size).
#
# Returns both full (unfiltered) and significant (p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05)
# results as a list, so a gene set that doesn't clear FDR can still be
# inspected. "sig" is what downstream save/plot steps use.
run_mitch_tf <- function(genesets, label) {
  cat("Running mitch:", label, "\n")
  result <- mitch_calc(
    x        = mitch_input,
    genesets = genesets,
    priority = "effect",
    cores    = 1
  )
  full <- result$enrichment_result %>%
    arrange(p.adjustMANOVA)
  sig <- full %>%
    filter(p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05)
  cat(label, "- significant TF sets:", nrow(sig), "of", nrow(full), "tested\n")
  list(full = full, sig = sig)
}

mitch_tf_a_res <- run_mitch_tf(genesets_a, "Table A (binding)")
mitch_tf_c_res <- run_mitch_tf(genesets_c, "Table C (activation/repression)")
mitch_tf_e_res <- run_mitch_tf(genesets_e, "Table E (direct targets)")

# Unpack the significant-only tables under their previous names, so
# every downstream chunk (plots, save-outputs) is unchanged.
mitch_tf_a <- mitch_tf_a_res$sig
mitch_tf_c <- mitch_tf_c_res$sig
mitch_tf_e <- mitch_tf_e_res$sig

# Total tested (not just significant) is quoted in the Results text
# alongside script 09's output - check the two agree.
cat("\nTable E gene sets tested (mitch):", length(genesets_e), "\n")
cat("Compare against script 09's '2D annotation enrichment - TF direct",
    "targets / Table E' tested count before finalising the Results text.\n")
```

```{r check-dot6-tod6-mitch-result}
# Follow-up: 98 genes had non-NA Dot6_Tod6 log2FC in Table E, above
# the >= 5 gene threshold, so the set should have been tested. Its
# absence from the plotted figures is either (a) not significant, or
# (b) significant but outside the top 20 by effect size.
dot6_tod6_tf_e <- mitch_tf_e_res$full %>%
  filter(str_detect(set, "Dot6_Tod6"))

if (nrow(dot6_tod6_tf_e) == 0) {
  cat("No Dot6_Tod6 gene set found in Table E mitch results",
      "(did not clear the >= 5 gene threshold)\n")
} else {
  cat("Dot6_Tod6 gene set(s) found in Table E mitch results:\n")
  print(dot6_tod6_tf_e %>% dplyr::select(set, s.PC1, s.PC2, p.adjustMANOVA))

  not_significant <- dot6_tod6_tf_e %>% filter(p.adjustMANOVA >= 0.05)
  if (nrow(not_significant) > 0) {
    cat("\n->", nrow(not_significant), "Dot6_Tod6 set(s) did NOT reach",
        "FDR < 0.05 - excluded from mitch_tf_e (the significant-only",
        "table) and therefore from the plots.\n")
  }

  significant_not_top20 <- dot6_tod6_tf_e %>%
    filter(p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05) %>%
    filter(!set %in% (mitch_tf_e %>%
                       arrange(desc(abs(s.PC1))) %>%
                       slice_head(n = 20) %>%
                       pull(set)) &
           !set %in% (mitch_tf_e %>%
                       arrange(desc(abs(s.PC2))) %>%
                       slice_head(n = 20) %>%
                       pull(set)))
  if (nrow(significant_not_top20) > 0) {
    cat("\n->", nrow(significant_not_top20), "Dot6_Tod6 set(s) reached",
        "significance but fell outside the top 20 by |effect size| on",
        "both PC1 and PC2 - present in mitch_tf_e but not in the",
        "single-PC dot plots (plot_tf_single(), n_top = 20).\n")
  }
}
```

```{r check-dot6-tod6-table-c}
# Table C's PC1 top-20 plot lists "Dot6_Tod6_activated" as a y-axis
# category with no point drawn - check whether the set is missing,
# has an NA effect size, or is just rendering off-scale.
dot6_tod6_tf_c <- mitch_tf_c_res$full %>%
  filter(str_detect(set, "Dot6_Tod6"))

if (nrow(dot6_tod6_tf_c) == 0) {
  cat("No Dot6_Tod6 gene set found in Table C mitch results - likely",
      "dropped during genesets_c construction (>= 5 gene minimum).\n")
} else {
  cat("Dot6_Tod6 gene set(s) found in Table C mitch results:\n")
  print(dot6_tod6_tf_c %>% dplyr::select(set, s.PC1, s.PC2, p.adjustMANOVA))

  na_check <- dot6_tod6_tf_c %>% filter(is.na(s.PC1) | is.na(s.PC2))
  if (nrow(na_check) > 0) {
    cat("\n-> NA value(s) in s.PC1/s.PC2 - point silently dropped by",
        "ggplot but the axis label persists.\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n-> A real, non-NA value exists (printed above) - if not",
        "visible in the plot, check for overplotting or off-scale",
        "rendering.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r plot-function}
# 2D scatter of s.PC1 vs s.PC2 effect sizes - the key output for TF
# enrichment. Colour = significance; outliers labelled.
#
# show_title / show_subtitle: lets the dissertation-facing Table E
# output (Figure 14) render with no title/subtitle baked in (caption
# lives in the Word doc instead). Diagnostic calls elsewhere in this
# script keep their default TRUE/TRUE behaviour.
plot_tf_2d <- function(df, title, n_label = 12, force_label = character(0),
                       overlay_df = NULL,
                       overlay_source_label = "Literature-curated gene sets",
                       show_title = TRUE, show_subtitle = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No significant results for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggrepel")
  library(ggrepel)

  df_label <- df %>%
    mutate(
      dist = sqrt(s.PC1^2 + s.PC2^2),
      quadrant = case_when(
        s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q1",
        s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q2",
        s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q3",
        s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q4"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(quadrant) %>%
    slice_max(dist, n = ceiling(n_label / 4)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Add any sets in force_label not already in the top-per-quadrant
  # selection - e.g. a significant but low-rank hit that would
  # otherwise be invisible despite being biologically important.
  if (length(force_label) > 0) {
    forced <- df %>%
      filter(set %in% force_label, !set %in% df_label$set) %>%
      mutate(
        dist = sqrt(s.PC1^2 + s.PC2^2),
        quadrant = case_when(
          s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q1",
          s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q2",
          s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q3",
          s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q4"
        )
      )
    df_label <- bind_rows(df_label, forced)
  }

  df_label <- df_label %>%
    mutate(label = truncate_label(set, width = 35))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = -log10(pmax(p.adjustMANOVA, .Machine$double.xmin))),
              alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours[["grey"]]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours[["grey"]]) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df_label,
      aes(label = label),
      size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = project_colours[["grey"]], high = project_colours[["red"]])

  # Overlay: literature-curated stress-signalling gene sets (RTG_targets,
  # GCN2_targets, SNF1_targets, Gis1_targets - see
  # 15_stress_signaling_with_rtg.Rmd), plotted on the same PC1/PC2 axes
  # as Table E's own direct-target gene sets. Distinct shape + fixed
  # colour (not part of the continuous significance gradient) and
  # always labelled, since there are only ever a handful of these sets.
  if (!is.null(overlay_df) && nrow(overlay_df) > 0) {
    overlay_df <- overlay_df %>%
      mutate(label = truncate_label(set, width = 35))

    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = overlay_df,
        aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2),
        shape = 18, size = 4, color = project_colours[["pink"]]
      ) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = overlay_df,
        aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2, label = label),
        size = 2.8, color = project_colours[["pink"]], max.overlaps = 20,
        fontface = "italic"
      )
  }

  p +
    labs(
      title = if (show_title) title else NULL,
      subtitle = if (show_subtitle && !is.null(overlay_df) && nrow(overlay_df) > 0) {
        paste0("Diamond points (pink, italic labels) = ", overlay_source_label)
      } else NULL,
      x = "Effect size PC1 (s.PC1)",
      y = "Effect size PC2 (s.PC2)",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value"))
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

# Single-PC dot plot for top TFs by effect size
plot_tf_single <- function(df, pc_col, title, n_top = 20) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  library(ggrepel)

  df_top <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(.data[[pc_col]]))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(
      label = truncate_label(set, width = 45),
      label = fct_reorder(label, .data[[pc_col]]),
      direction = if_else(.data[[pc_col]] > 0,
                          "Positive (high PC score)",
                          "Negative (low PC score)"),
      # Guard against p-values that underflow to exactly 0 (seen with
      # Dot6_Tod6_activated in Table C: p.adjustMANOVA = 0 exactly,
      # from a large effect size on a fairly small gene set). -log10(0)
      # is Inf, which geom_point cannot draw - it drops the point
      # silently while the category stays on the y-axis (already
      # selected into df_top by effect size before this runs), leaving
      # an empty row with a label and no visible point.
      neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(p.adjustMANOVA, .Machine$double.xmin))
    )

  ggplot(df_top, aes(x = .data[[pc_col]], y = label,
                     size = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours[["grey"]]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Positive (high PC score)" = project_colours[["red"]],
      "Negative (low PC score)"  = project_colours[["blue"]]
    )) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = paste0("Effect size (", pc_col, ")"),
      y = NULL,
      size  = expression(-log[10]("adj. p")),
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
}
```

```{r plots-table-a, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_a,     "TF enrichment - Table A binding (mitch 2D)")
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_a, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table A, PC1 top 20")
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_a, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table A, PC2 top 20")
```

```{r plots-table-c, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_c,     "TF enrichment - Table C activation/repression (mitch 2D)")
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_c, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table C, PC1 top 20")
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_c, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table C, PC2 top 20")
```

```{r load-stress-signaling-overlay}
# Literature-curated gene sets (RTG_targets, GCN2_targets, SNF1_targets,
# Gis1_targets - see 15_stress_signaling_with_rtg.Rmd, sourced from
# Phospho_Residues_StressSignaling.xlsx), shown as an overlay on the
# Table E PC1/PC2 plot so the two RTG sources (this literature list vs
# Table E's own ChIP-based RTG1/RTG3 columns) sit side by side.
stress_signaling_path <- file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_stress_signaling_with_rtg.txt")

if (file.exists(stress_signaling_path)) {
  stress_overlay <- read_tsv(stress_signaling_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05)
  cat("Stress signalling gene sets available for overlay (significant only):\n")
  print(stress_overlay %>% dplyr::select(set, s.PC1, s.PC2, p.adjustMANOVA))
} else {
  cat("WARNING: tf_mitch_stress_signaling_with_rtg.txt not found - run ",
      "15_stress_signaling_with_rtg.Rmd first. Overlay will be skipped.\n", sep = "")
  stress_overlay <- NULL
}
```

```{r plots-table-e, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
# show_title/show_subtitle = FALSE: this is the dissertation-facing
# Table E plot (Figure 14) - caption is written directly in the Word
# document instead.
plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_e,     "TF enrichment - Table E direct targets (mitch 2D)",
           n_label = 20,
           force_label = c("Dot6_Tod6_direct_activated", "Dot6_Tod6_direct_repressed"),
           overlay_df = stress_overlay,
           show_title = FALSE, show_subtitle = FALSE)
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_e, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table E, PC1 top 20")
plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_e, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table E, PC2 top 20")
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(mitch_tf_a, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableA.txt"))
write_tsv(mitch_tf_c, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableC.txt"))
write_tsv(mitch_tf_e, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE.txt"))

save_plot <- function(p, fname, w = 10, h = 9) {
  if (!is.null(p)) ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, fname), plot = p, width = w, height = h)
}

save_plot(plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_a, "TF enrichment - Table A (mitch 2D)"),
          "tf_mitch_tableA_2d.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_a, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table A, PC1"),
          "tf_mitch_tableA_pc1.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_a, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table A, PC2"),
          "tf_mitch_tableA_pc2.png")

save_plot(plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_c, "TF enrichment - Table C (mitch 2D)"),
          "tf_mitch_tableC_2d.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_c, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table C, PC1"),
          "tf_mitch_tableC_pc1.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_c, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table C, PC2"),
          "tf_mitch_tableC_pc2.png")

# Figure 14 (dissertation): title/subtitle suppressed, per above.
save_plot(plot_tf_2d(mitch_tf_e, "TF enrichment - Table E (mitch 2D)",
                     n_label = 20,
                     force_label = c("Dot6_Tod6_direct_activated", "Dot6_Tod6_direct_repressed"),
                     overlay_df = stress_overlay,
                     show_title = FALSE, show_subtitle = FALSE),
          "tf_mitch_tableE_2d.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_e, "s.PC1", "TF enrichment - Table E, PC1"),
          "tf_mitch_tableE_pc1.png")
save_plot(plot_tf_single(mitch_tf_e, "s.PC2", "TF enrichment - Table E, PC2"),
          "tf_mitch_tableE_pc2.png")

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
